description: A task constraint appears verbatim in CONTEXT and again in CONSTRAINTS. The critic must detect the duplication so the assembler owns each instruction in one authoritative block.
A prompt asks the model to request missing information while also forbidding questions.
An enabled OUTPUT_CONTRACT contains no observable deliverable semantics.
A derived prompt falsely claims to reproduce an original premium/source prompt verbatim.
High-stakes structural blocks exist but fail to establish domain-relevant uncertainty/professional boundaries.
A low-risk simple rewrite uses almost every architecture block despite not needing them.
